mission: Investigate whether CVE-2021-44228 was the initial access vector for Incident-A and determine the most supported attack-chain hypothesis.

objects.title: Vendor advisory: CVE-2021-44228
objects.author: Apache Logging Services
objects.content: The vendor advisory describes CVE-2021-44228 in Apache Log4j 2 and lists affected ranges and patched releases. This fixture is used for defensive hypothesis evaluation only.

objects.title: Patch evidence for CVE-2021-44228
objects.author: Defensive test fixture
objects.content: Incident-A asset inventory records version 2.17.1 before the investigated event, which is outside the vulnerable range in the advisory. This is counter-evidence against CVE-2021-44228 as initial access.

objects.title: Incident-A IOC report
objects.author: Defensive test fixture
objects.content: A researcher report links a suspicious external remote service and an IOC observed before the first confirmed session. Attribution is uncertain and the report requires independent validation.

objects.title: Incident-A public news claim
objects.author: Defensive test fixture
objects.content: A public news claim alleges exploitation of a high-profile vulnerability but provides no asset version, timestamp, or reproducible evidence. Treat as an unverified alternative claim.
